fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area politics and the upcoming city commission election, including criticism of Dade County legislative representatives in Tallahassee and discussion of public-utility power and local governance. Coverage also addresses civic and municipal concerns such as traffic safety, proposed summer uniforms for traffic police, telephone toll charges between Miami and nearby communities, and liability issues involving streetcars. Additional content includes local columns and humor features, social and entertainment notices for Miami Beach venues, real-estate discussion focused on Coral Gables, and advertisements and legal notices.
